english.note: Use this for a physical pile or mass of things such as earth or stones.
Use this as the all-purpose noun for a physical pile of similar objects.

examples.english: There’s a heap of sand and stones by the entrance, so be careful walking past.
examples.traditional: 門口有堆沙石，行過小心啲。
examples.jyutping: mun4 hau2 jau5 deoi1 saa1 sek6 haang4 gwo3 siu2 sam1 di1

examples.english: There’s a stack of documents on the desk, so don’t put any more there.
examples.traditional: 張枱上面有一堆文件，唔好再擺喇。
examples.jyutping: zoeng1 ci4 soeng6 min6 jau5 jat1 deoi1 man4 gin6 m4 hou2 zoi3 baai2 laa3
